title: RAW UNREVIEWED: fixed opaque ritual blocks coexist with independently configurable ordinary-language petitions
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Complete Liber iuratus XXXV–XXXVIII units alternate opaque voces with petitions containing explicit substitution instructions. Ars notoria50–56 distinguishes these registers and denies exhaustive wordwise exposition. A whole-account reading must preserve fixed recitation identity separately from the requested outcome and execution order. Medieval clause ownership remains to be checked; no Voynich meanings selected.

design.historical_production_class: Ritual recitation can transmit phonetic/formal carriers as operative wholes while instructions, timing and petition content remain ordinary-language clauses. This is neither random-copy simulation nor necessarily ordinary prose hidden under letter substitution.

precise_finite_candidates.BILINGUAL_WORDWISE: Adjoining ordinary-language exposition translates all opaque words under one reusable word-level lexicon.
precise_finite_candidates.RITUAL_BLOCK_PLUS_SLOT: Opaque block identity is reused as one ritual unit; the expressly designated ordinary petition slot carries a configurable desired outcome. Instructions govern ordering and timing.
precise_finite_candidates.OPAQUE_NAMES_INSIDE_ORDINARY_PROSE: Every opaque item is an ordinary argument name inserted into an otherwise compositional sentence; no complete recitation-block layer.

design.unequal_source_consequence: An explicitly substituted petition changes the requested outcome without an instruction to rewrite every opaque token. Ars notoria56 expressly excludes exhaustive lexical exposition. Thus treating the adjoining prose as a complete aligned plaintext is unjustified. The third candidate is not universally excluded: mixed ordinary sentences and names occur elsewhere and must remain separately typed.
design.nontrivial_written_constraint: A complete account must separate cited recitation block from executable instruction and configurable request. The same opaque sequence can retain identity under a changed request, but moving its prescribed performance point changes the operation. An incipit alone is not another free semantic label.
design.production_rule_limit: This is a rule for assembling complete accounts, NOT an established generative rule for every opaque word or proof that no historical hearer understood any word. Descriptive near-word families do not confer decoded semantic components.
design.historical_ownership_limit: Late Agrippa/Turner Ars notoria version is not assumed identical to early witnesses. Royal transcription is not pooled with corrected Sloane/GH composite. Root must verify specific clauses in its selected early witness; general existence of a medieval title is insufficient.
design.known_constraints: GDT605 learned units not alphabet;608 directed composition and whole-form residuals still require explanation. GDT001/168 structure/copy controls unchanged, not claimed passed. No arbitrary frequent-word meanings.

predecessors.retained: Failed fixed Picatrix seven-record common closing formula unchanged; not a general absence of opaque ritual register.
Failed exact Sator equations unchanged; no alternate word boundaries or formula repairs.
Already covers chant cue completion. Current proposed distinction requires independently configurable petition against fixed opaque block; pure incipit reuse would duplicate901.
Recursive mnemonic index law has its retained exact source mismatch; opaque orations are not a repair or relabeling of that tree.

design.smallest_next_step: Root source inquiry verifies medieval native formula block plus adjacent operative/translation-status instruction in one witness. If absent, retain late source evidence but do not promote early production claim. No target model selected until an entire admitted unit receives competing fixed construction accounts with profiles/counterexamples governing any lexical priorities.
design.current_target_capacity: No target access, query, statistical scoring, new image, reserve or decoder. No claimed native analogue or translated word.
design.falsification_limit: A broadly unconstrained mixture of ritual and prose can fit anything and is not proposed as a test. Any selected descendant must freeze complete block boundaries, repetition identity and configurable slots before evaluating consequences; no adjustment after contradictions.
